args.subject: Open orders under the BCX Interconnect name
args.body:
Dear BCX Interconnect team,

Thank you for your note of 2 September about the change of name from Baycrest Connectors to BCX Interconnect. We are updating our records and would like to confirm a few things on our open orders.

Please acknowledge the six open lines below under the BCX Interconnect name and confirm the promised date on each:

HPO-26-00490/50 · HR-20111 · 3000 EA
HPO-26-00490/90 · HR-20135 · 260 EA
HPO-26-00490/100 · HR-20140 · 3700 EA
HPO-26-00490/110 · HR-21125 · 1192 EA
HPO-26-00490/80 · HR-20133 · 1500 EA
HPO-26-00591/40 · HR-20137 · 540 EA

Please also tell us where each line stands (being made, shipped, or in transit), and send the packing list and carrier once a line ships.

Please confirm that orders@bcxinterconnect.example is the right address for purchase orders, order acknowledgements and ship notices from now on, and that the delivery terms on these orders are unchanged. Please also tell us the name and address we should use for your accounts and remittance contact, so we can update our records before the old addresses stop forwarding on 31 December.

Please reply as soon as you can.

Best regards,
Priya Nair
